description: Heptad propensity of the retained stub versus the shed ectodomain, with TM-overlapping windows excluded
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
seq="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9H9K5.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
HYD=set('LIVMFAWY')
def heptad(s):
    return max(sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) if ((i+f)%7) in (0,3) and s[i] in HYD)/
               len([i for i in range(len(s)) if ((i+f)%7) in (0,3)]) for f in range(7))

W=21   # shorter window so it fits inside the 56-aa stub without touching the TM
cent=np.array([i+W//2+1 for i in range(len(seq)-W+1)])
sc=np.array([heptad(seq[i:i+W]) for i in range(len(seq)-W+1)])
# a window centred at c spans c-10..c+10 ; fully inside 433-488 means 443<=c<=478
rng=np.random.default_rng(0); arr=np.array(list(seq[26:432]))
null=np.array([heptad("".join(rng.permutation(arr)[:W])) for _ in range(2000)])
thr=np.quantile(null,0.95)

rows=[]
for a,b,lab in [(37,422,'shed ectodomain interior (windows fully inside 27-432)'),
                (443,478,'retained stub interior (windows fully inside 433-488)')]:
    m=(cent>=a)&(cent<=b)
    frac=(sc[m]>thr).mean()
    rows.append(dict(region=lab,span=f"{a}-{b}",n_windows=int(m.sum()),
                     mean=round(float(sc[m].mean()),3),max=round(float(sc[m].max()),3),
                     frac_above_null95=round(float(frac),3)))
t=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(f"W={W}; shuffled-ectodomain null: mean {null.mean():.3f}, 95th pct {thr:.3f}\n")
print(t.to_string(index=False))

ms=(cent>=37)&(cent<=422); mr=(cent>=443)&(cent<=478)
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
U,p=mannwhitneyu(sc[mr],sc[ms],alternative='greater')
d=(sc[mr].mean()-sc[ms].mean())/np.sqrt((sc[mr].var(ddof=1)*(mr.sum()-1)+sc[ms].var(ddof=1)*(ms.sum()-1))/(mr.sum()+ms.sum()-2))
print(f"\nStub vs shed ectodomain, Mann-Whitney one-sided: U={U:.0f}, p={p:.2g}, Cohen's d={d:.2f}")
print("NOTE: adjacent windows overlap by 20/21 residues, so p is anti-conservative; read d and the")
print("      fraction-above-null as the effect, not the p-value.")
print(f"\nStub sequence 433-488: {seq[432:488]}")
print(f"Pro in 446-488: {seq[445:488].count('P')}  |  Pro in 27-432: {seq[26:432].count('P')} / 406 = {seq[26:432].count('P')/406:.1%}")
t.to_csv('ERVMER34-1_stub_heptad_propensity.csv',index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.2),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[2.2,1]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(cent,sc,lw=1,color='#2b6cb0')
ax.axhline(thr,ls='--',color='#c53030',lw=1.2,label=f'95th pct, shuffled ectodomain ({thr:.2f})')
ax.axvspan(443,478,color='#9ae6b4',alpha=.6,label='retained stub interior 443-478')
ax.axvspan(489,509,color='#cbd5e0',alpha=.8,label='TM 489-509 (excluded)')
ax.axvline(432.5,color='k',lw=1.8); ax.text(432.5,1.04,'Q432/R433',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('residue (window centre)'); ax.set_ylabel('heptad propensity (a/d hydrophobic fraction)')
ax.set_ylim(0,1.12); ax.set_xlim(1,len(seq)); ax.legend(fontsize=7.5,loc='lower left')
ax.set_title('Heptad propensity along HEMO, window 21',fontsize=10)
ax=axes[1]
ax.boxplot([sc[ms],sc[mr]],labels=['shed ectodomain\n37-422','retained stub\n443-478'],widths=.55,
           patch_artist=True,boxprops=dict(facecolor='#bee3f8'),medianprops=dict(color='k'))
ax.axhline(thr,ls='--',color='#c53030',lw=1.2)
ax.set_ylabel('heptad propensity'); ax.set_ylim(0,1.05)
ax.set_title(f"d = {d:.2f}; {rows[1]['frac_above_null95']:.0%} vs {rows[0]['frac_above_null95']:.0%}\nof windows above the null 95th pct",fontsize=9)
plt.suptitle('The 56-residue membrane-retained stub of HEMO carries coiled-coil heptad character, unlike the flexible\nunstructured juxtamembrane stalks that ADAM10 and ADAM17 require in their substrates',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
